maddeler.e:
انحبست (form VII)
# اِنْحَبَسْتُ (inḥabastu) /in.ħa.bas.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
# اِنْحَبَسْتَ (inḥabasta) /in.ħa.bas.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
# اِنْحَبَسْتِ (inḥabasti) /in.ħa.bas.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْحَبَسَ (inḥabasa)
# اِنْحَبَسَتْ (inḥabasat) /in.ħa.ba.sat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
